name: Threshold effects

subjectOf.text: Where the Form PF quarterly reporting threshold does influence behavior, it distorts fund size downward: a majority of the advisers who take the threshold into account plan to stay under $1.5 billion in assets under management, and some would close funds to new investors to do so.
subjectOf.abstract: A majority of those respondents who would take it into account plan to stay under the Form PF threshold for quarterly reporting of $1.5 billion AUM.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Hedge Fund Manager Registration Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2012). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2150377
scope_conditions: the 19.54% of respondents who would take the Form PF threshold into account

subjectOf.text: The Dodd-Frank Act registration threshold creates incentives strong enough that some advisers opt out of registration and disclosure by strategically changing their AUM size to stay below $150 million.
subjectOf.abstract: It is possible that the enactment of the Dodd-Frank Act introduces incentives that are powerful enough to cause some hedge fund advisers to opt out of Dodd-Frank Act registration and disclosure through a strategic change of AUM size.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
scope_conditions: advisers with AUM floating around the $150 million threshold

subjectOf.text: Some large advisers reduce their AUM in the months from May to August 2012, which strongly increases the discontinuity around the registration threshold and separates the two groups more sharply, though the effect vanishes late in the sample period.
subjectOf.abstract: In particular, some large advisers reduce their AUM. This leads to a strong increase in the discontinuity around the AUM registration threshold, suggesting a stronger separation between the two groups. The effect vanishes during the last months of our sample period.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Barbara Luppi, Sandra Paterlini, Did the Dodd-Frank Act Impact Hedge Fund Performance (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2389416
